Tum lambi seedhi chadhe, basin ki tip-tip andhere mein peeche aati — boot mein aadhi-kati key aur sone ki dawai, aur do naye guards ke paar us tak pahunchne ka koi raasta nahi. Subah phansi thi. Tum bhi nahi soye.
— Chapter 13 khatam —

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Subah dhoosar aur pakki aayi. Unhone use cradle se utara — teen din bina neend, ek raat peeche jhuke, ab wo mushkil se khadi ho paati thi; reedh ek saath seedhi nahi hoti thi, har stage pe awaaz nikalwati. Unhone use aadha uthakar bahar roshni mein laaya jo usne hafte se nahi dekhi thi.
Poora shehar aa gaya tha, chowk kandhe se kandha bhar, aur jab wo dikhi, aankhein meechti tootiti, jo awaaz unhone nikali wo insan ki nahi thi — das hazaar gale ki nafrat ki deewar.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Unhone use scaffold pe rassi ke neeche khada kiya. King Mordane ne ek haath uthaya aur chowk chup ho gaya. "Rajdhani ke logon, is aurat se ek cheez maangi gayi thi jo uski zindagi kharid leti. Main ek baar aur poochhunga, jahan tum sab sun sako." Wo uski taraf muda. "Everspring, Elara. Bolo, aur jeeti ho. Chup raho, to ye ache log tumhe girte dekhenge."

Usne sir uthaya, aur poore chowk ko apna barbaad chehra dikhaya. "Tumhara raja hamesha jeena chahta hai. Yahi raaz hai jiske liye usne mujhe teen hafte torture kiya. Suraksha nahi — *hamesha.* Khud se poocho, aisa aadmi hazaar saal kya karega." Wo dagmagayi, sambhali. "Main aaj marungi taaki wo na kar sake. Ye sabse accha tohfa hai jo main tumhare bacchon ko kabhi dungi. Rassi kheench do."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Ye raja ke haq mein galat baat thi. Bheed mein gungunahat phaili — bechaini ki chhoti lehar, das hazaar dimaagon mein ek sawal: *hamesha?* Wo rassi ko martyr nahi bana sakta tha jab wo shabd hawa mein latka ho.
"Nahi," usne kaha, haath neeche karte hue. "Jaldi girna uske hisab se bahut saaf hai jo usne kamaya. Aaj wo *tumhara* hisab degi."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Unhone use scaffold ke kinare pillory mein jakad diya — bhaari oak frame gardan aur kalaiyan dabaye, use jhuka aur majboor khada rakhta.

"Teen hafte mere sawaliyon ke paas thi, kuch nahi mila," raja chillaya. "Shayad jinhe usne nuksan diya wo behtar karen. Ye yahan khadi rahegi shaam tak. Sirf maregi nahi — phansi mera haq hai, jab main chahun."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Usne tumhe aur guards ki line pillory ke pair pe lagayi — uski raksha ke liye nahi, apni property ki raksha ke liye. Tumhare orders: mob ko use maarne se roko, aur usse kam sab kuch hone do.
To tum us aurat aur us shehar ke beech khade rahe jo use marna chahta tha, talwar sirf is liye ijazat thi ki use buri maut tak zinda rakho.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Wo baadh ki tarah aaye — sade phal, gandagi, thook — poora shehar apni nafrat ek aurat pe khaali karta jo aankh ponchhne ko haath bhi nahi utha sakti thi. Ek boodhe ne switch se chehre pe maara jab tak guard ne peeche na dhakela.

Kuch ne ye kamaya tha — wo aurat jo phenkte hue ro rahi thi, wo aadmi jo har patthar pe bete ka naam leta tha. Elara ne unke khet jalaaye the. Us chowk ka gham sach tha, aur koi saaf jagah nahi thi jahan khade raho.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Dopahar tak ek aurat shears leke chadhi aur shor ke saath baal kaat diye; wo keechad mein gire aur kuchle gaye. Phenke cobble ne maathe ko khola aur khoon aankhon mein behne laga jo wo ponchh nahi sakti thi — aur phir bhi, har ghante, wo jakda sir oak jitna allow karta utna uthati aur unka saamna karti, unke aage nahi roti, bheekh nahi mangti.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Do baar aadmiyon ne maarne wale patthar phenke. Dono baar tum bina soche hil gaye — shield ne ek liya, doosre ka baaju hataya. Usne mehsoos kiya. Ek baar, jab kaafi paas the, phate hothon se do shabd saans mein, sirf tumse: "Abhi nahi." Keh rahi thi thaame raho — das hazaar gawahon ke saamne use bachane mein sab barbaad mat karo.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Ye chalta raha jab tak roshni amber na ho gayi aur bheed ke haath thak na gaye. Shaam tak chowk khali ho raha tha, aur pillory mein jo bacha tha wo mushkil se hilta tha.

Vance use kholne aaya. "Abhi saans le rahi hai," usne note kiya, barbaad chehra thodi se uthate hue. "Raja ne rassi ka naya din set nahi kiya. Jab tootogi tab phansi, usse pehle nahi. Kal ho sakta hai. Bahut, bahut lambi der bhi."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Unhone use andhere mein utaar liya, aur tum wo the jinhone gandagi aur khoon dhoya, haath kamapte. Dono ne wo nahi kaha jo ab dono jaante the: koi phansi ki tareekh nahi bachi jisse *pehle* bhaga jaaye — sirf khule din jisme raja use tab tak dard dega jab tak usse mar na jaye, kisi schedule pe nahi, bas uske sabr pe.
Jo clock tum bhaag rahe the wo gayab ho gayi. Aur jis aadmi ke paas deadline nahi, wo perfect raat ka intezaar nahi karta — wo khud ek banata hai.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Us raat aakhir wo soi, shareer ki wo marri neend jisme kuch nahi bacha, nanga sir tumhari god mein, tumhari peeth cell ke darwaze ki taraf — jab tum jaagte baithe guards ginte, pahre ki badli, eent wali naali ki thandi saans, ungliyon mein aadhi-kati key ghumate.
Koi deadline nahi. Koi perfect raat nahi. Bas ek princess jisne poore shehar se sach kaha aur jee gayi, aur ek guard jiske paas intezaar karne ki wajahein aakhir, poori tarah, khatam ho chuki thin.
— Chapter 14 khatam —

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Ab raja ke paas calendar nahi tha, aur isse wo aur bura ho gaya. Kai din use sadne diya, phir naya raasta mila: tumhari behen. "Darwaze ke peeche dard afwah hai," usne kaha. "Dhoop mein dard lever hai. Hum wahan karenge jahan shehar dekh sake wo choose karti hai."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Unhone deewaron ke neeche khuli zameen pe banaya: lakdi ka A-frame, tip pe pulley-wheel, ek rassi jiske dono chhor pe noosed cuff. Bheed pehle se ikatthi thi — wahi shehar jisne use patthar maare the.
Unhone *tumse* lagwaya. Vance tumhare upar khada raha jab tumne behen ki kalaiyan baandhin, phir princess ki, aur rassi thread ki, knot-knot pe seekhte hue ye zulm kaise chalta hai.

Vance ne bheed ko showman ki tarah samjhaya. "Simple, aur fair. Is taraf ki ladki kamzor hai. Princess mazboot hai, to hum mazboot ko kamzor uthane dete hain. Hum Highness pe wazan latkaate hain — jab tak wo thaame, ladki aaram se khadi. Jaise hi princess jhukti hai, ladki bandi bahon se zameen se upar khinchti hai jab tak kandhe sockets se na nikal jaayein. Princess khud ki taakat se decide karti hai bacchi ko dard hoga ya nahi."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Phir unhone use load kiya — lohe ki silli ke baad silli wrist-cuff pe, baaju upar aur peeche khinchte jab tak usne bhi dheemi jaanwar si awaaz na di. Minuteon mein kandhon ki khal gehri, gusse wali laal ho gayi, khoon atka aur dhadakta jahan cords kaatte the.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Nessa, itni kamzor ki khud ko steady nahi rakh paati, baar-baar de deti; har baar jab wo dagmagati rassi princess ko panjon pe khinch leti, kandhe cheekhte, jab tak wo eidiyon ko wapas neeche laati aur dono ko sambhalti.

"Hilli mat, Nessa," Elara ne faasle paar saans mein kaha. "Isse mat lado, jaan. Main tumhe thaame hue hoon. Khadi raho, aur mujhe dono thaamne do." Tumhari behen royi aur koshish ki, aur har fail princess ne bahon mein bhugta — aur ek baar bhi rassi ko use girne nahi diya.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Raja dekhata raha, asantusht — thaamna todna nahi hai. "Vance. Use girne ki wajah do, aur dekhein kya wo ladki gira degi apni khal bachane. Whip maaro."

Vance ke chehre pe zulm se bhi bura kuch jala — shukriya. Yahan uska favor mein wapas aane ka raasta tha, aur wo princess ke shareer pe se guzarta tha. "Tumne mujhe bahut nuksan diya, Highness," dheere kaha. "Kuch wapas lene do."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Pehli lash seene pe padi, aadhe bharte daagon pe, unhe phir khol diya. Par asal zulm wo tha jo ye maangta tha: agar wo hinchki aur baaju ek haath bhar bhi gire, Nessa zameen se khich jaayegi. To wo hinch nahi sakti thi — har waar bilkul sthir khadi le, whip ko shareer mein samaati jise hilna mana tha.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Vance ne whip baar-baar aage maara, aur har ek usne bina gire liya. Chaabukon ke beech usne use gaali nahi di, raja se bheekh nahi maangi — tumhari behen se boli. "Almost khatam, Nessa. Line mein bhai dekho — wo tumhe ghar le jayega. Bas khadi raho, jaan."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tum guard-line mein khade the jahan usne ladki ko dekhne ko kaha tha, dekhte hue sabse bahadur cheez jo kabhi dekhi, jaante hue tumne wo knots baandhe the jinase ye mumkin hua.

Ek baar Nessa ke pair bilkul chhoot gaye, aur rassi ne Elara ko poori tarah zameen se uchhaal diya, aakhir cheekhti hue — phir usne ek panja neeche kiya, wapas khincha, aur haanfkar kaha, "Theek hai. Main tumhe thaame hue hoon. Khadi raho." Wo us rassi pe mar jati usse pehle ki ladki giraati. Sab dekh sakte the, raja bhi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Pehle Vance ka baaju thaka. Usne use kisi ginti se aage whip maara, aur wo nahi giri, spring nahi diya, Nessa ko hawa chhune nahi diya — ek torturer jo victim nahi tod sakta, usne sabke saamne sabit kar diya wo natoot hai.
Raja utha aur khatam kiya, reham se nahi. "Bas. Neeche utaro." Saans mein: "...use tootna chahiye tha. Kyun nahi tootti."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Unhone loha neeche kiya. Nessa, poori, us aurat ne bachayi jo use ek inch giraane se pehle whip se kacchi ho gayi, tumhari bahon mein giri; Elara mitti pe fold hui, baaju galat latakte, itni hoshiyar ki dekhe ladki poori hai.
"Kaha tha," whisper kiya. "Main use thaame hue thi."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Us raat tum dono ke beech andhere mein baithe, aur tumhare andar kuch badalna khatam hua. Koi deadline nahi jeetni, koi perfect raat nahi aa rahi — sirf ek aurat jo khud barbaad hone degi usse pehle ki uska zulm jeete.
Us raat tumne ungliyon mein aadhi-kati key nahi ghumayi. Tumne use kaatkar poora kiya.
— Chapter 15 khatam —

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Taiyar hone mein do din lage — kaatna, file karna, bhagne ke liye churaana jo chahiye: rassi ka coil, nadi ke outflow ke neeche reeds mein chhupi skiff, sukhe kapde, neeli vial jo us din se boot mein thi jab tumne banayi thi.

Teesri raat, qile ne tumhe window di: great hall mein Vance ki feast, garrison uski sehat peetey mashalein thartharaane tak, aur toofan nadi pe chadhta, kala paani phailata, raat ko shor mein dubaata. Jo kuch tum intezaar kar rahe the, ek saath aa gaya. Tumne intezaar band kiya.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tumne dungeon-watch ko wine khud pahunchayi, neeli vial ko jug mein khali kar diya. Paune ghante mein niche landing ke dono aadmi kharrate le rahe the. Teesri-watch ka mashal wala apne time pe aaya, aur jab wo jhuka tumne use dheere litaya aur belt se key-ring utha li. Do darwazon jitna loha. Nessa, aur Elara.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tum pehle uske paas neeche gaye — andar koi compass wahan hi ishara karta tha aur maanane se inkaar. Sabse gehri cell kaali aur tang thi, patthar se toofan ki awaaz bhari, aur uski ubhri, sambhli saansein. Haath itna kampa ki key lock pe khadkhadai pehle, phir ghumi, aur jo darwaza tumne sau baar band kiya tha, pehli baar tum pe khula.
Usne galat awaaz suni aur straw mein peeche hinchki, jo bhi naya ho uska intezaar karti. "...Jo bhi ho," whisper kiya, "kar do aur sone do. Main phir bhi na hi kahungi—"

"Elara." Tum ghutnon pe the pehle ki jaante hilte. "Main hoon. Suno — watch neeche hai, toofan humhe dhak raha hai, feast ne baaki ko pee rakha hai, aur nadi ki naali ke neeche reeds mein naav hai. Samajh rahi ho main kya keh raha hoon?"
Wo bilkul sthir hui, phir ek saath jaagi. "Phir kaho," saans mein. "Saaf, taaki main jaanoon tum ho, mera dimaag zalim nahi ho raha."

"Aaj raat," tumne kaha, uska thanda chehra dono haathon mein lete hue. "Aaj raat main tumhe yahan se nikaalta hoon. Dono ko. Sirf hum hain, deewar mein ek ched, aur ek nadi. Main tumhe ghar le ja raha hoon."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Usne awaaz di jo na sisak thi na hansi aur dono thi, aur geela chehra tumhari hatheli pe dabaya — wahi haath jisne pehli raat cords dheele kiye the aur sabse bure din namak zakhmon mein daala tha. Ki wo ab bhi uski taraf mudti hai, ye tumhe poori tarah tod diya.
"Theek hai," khal ke khilaaf whisper kiya. "Main maanti hoon. Ye utaro aur mujhe andhere se bahar le chalo."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tumne chhukar cuff paaye — kalaiyan wazan se kachchi aur papdi — aur loha utna naram khola jitna kamapte haath ne diya. Jab aakhri gira, baaju bekaar latke, kandhe itne marode ki utha nahi sakte the. Usne chhoti tooti hansi di. "Kaam nahi kar rahe. Samaan ki tarah uthakar le jaana hoga."
"To main uthata hoon," tumne kaha. "Ek raat mujhe mazboot wala banne do."

Usne maathe ko tumhare maathe se lagaya, shareer ka iklauta hissa jo abhi maanta tha, aur wahan saans leti rahi tumhe andar leti hue. "Jaante ho," murmur kiya, "tum iklauti naram cheez ho jo barf ke baad mujhe hui. Unhone ek guard bheja tha zinda rakhne ko taaki barbaad kar saken, aur badle mein wahi wajah bana ki kuch bacha jo barbaad karne layak tha. Main hazaar wajahon se thi. Aakhri tum the."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Aur phir — upar toofan, neeche naav, intezaar ki poori zindagi is ek pal pe dabav — tumne andhere ka aakhri inch band kiya aur use chooma. Naram, phate hoth ka khayal rakhte, kiss jo kuch nahi mangti aur sab waada karti. Wo baaju nahi utha sakti thi, to shareer jo abhi saump sakta wahi diya — wapas chooma, tez aur kampata aur zinda, jab baarish girti rahi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Jab alag hue wo ro rahi thi aur muskurati bhi, aur tum bhi. "Watch sirf drug hui hai, ye bahut bewakoofi thi. Phir bhi ek baar aur karo." To tumne kiya — phir khud ko rokna pada, kyunki pyar use deewar paar nahi le jaayega, time le jaayega. Tumne baaju uske neeche slide kiye aur use us straw se uthaya jisme ek mahine se khoon bahaya tha.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Wazan almost kuch nahi — apna gham, unhone kitna le liya — par chhati se aise baithi jaise wahan fit hone bani ho, aur lambi kampti saans chhodi.
"Main tumhe thaame hue hoon," tumne baalon mein kaha — uske khud ke shabd jo behen ko kahe the, ab use wapas. "Andhera nahi. Ab nahi."

"Sun rahi hoon," whisper kiya. "To chalo. Behen lo, aur hum sab ko us nadi tak le chalo." Aur bhi dheere: "...Main tumse khatam nahi hui, guardsman. Jab azaad honge, hum apni baaki zindagi pe bahut lamba baat karenge."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tum use dungeon ki seedhi ke kale gale mein le gaye, dhadkan tumhari pasliyon pe, upar toofan garta, peeche drug watch bikhre, aur soya poora qila tumhare aur nadi ke beech.

Do darwazon ka loha jeb mein garam. Ek manzil upar behen intezaar. Khatam nahi — Vance ek hall door abhi apni sehat pee raha tha — par us pehli seedhi bhar, use dil se lagaye, tumne khud ko yakeen dilaya ki ye ho sakta hai.
— Chapter 16 khatam —

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Upar ki cells zyada sukhi thin, mashalein door-door, thand ab nadi se aa rahi thi — deewar ke paar sooja aur gusse mein, toofan use khila raha tha.

Tumne Elara ko seedhi ke mode pe sabse gehre saaye mein litaya. "Nessa upar hai," saans mein. "Aakhri cell, gallery ke end pe, aur ek guard. Tumhe yahan rukna hoga — tum mushkil se khadi ho." Usne jo haath abhi chalta tha usse sleeve jakdi.

"Main do saal chains mein kaam aane seekhti rahi," whisper kiya. "Jo raat main unse bahar hoon, mujhe bekaar mat banana. Behen ke liye tumhe dono haath chahihenge. Mujhe wo cheez banne do jise guard dekh raha ho."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tumhe nafrat thi ki wo sahi thi. "Agar galat ho," tumne kaha, "to deewar giraane jaisi cheekhna aur naali ki taraf bhagna. Mere peeche wapas mat aana."
"Jhoothe," naram se kaha. "Tum bhi ye order kabhi nahi maanoge." Aur usne sleeve chhod di.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Gallery ka guard, Holt, bore tha, peeth cells ki taraf, chehra slit window pe baarish dekhte. Elara pehle gayi — chalke, creep nahi, jaise sirf umda log chalte hain, nange pair aur barbaad bhi. Usne shackle-chain ek baar ghasiti taaki gaaye. Holt muda, cudgel pe haath, aur cudgel bilkul bhool gaya.

"Tum naya watch ho?" usne kaha, awaaz dheemi aur gunguni, banquet ki awaaz, cell ki nahi. "Khali kamron ki pahredari pe tum jaisa aadmi bhejte hain. Kya barbaadi." Wo usse zyada paas aayi jitna kaidi himmat kare. "Apna naam batao, watchman. Main is jagah se ek naram chehra yaad rakhna chahti hoon."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Kaam nahi karna chahiye tha — Holt ko bataya gaya tha wo saanp hai — par usne akeeli lambi raat ke akele aadmi pe darbaar ka poora jaadu ghumaya, aur wo uski taraf kadam badha, cells se poori tarah muda, aur naam kehne laga.
Uske peeche, tum nange pair gallery pe aaye, key-ring mutthi mein dabayi taaki baj na sake.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Nessa ki cell aakhri thi. Bars ke peeche, unnees saal, gehre chehre wali, jaagi, kalaiyan short wall-chain mein. Wo bars ki taraf jhatki; tumne ek ungli hothon pe itni zor dabayi ki dard hua. Wo sthir aur chup ho gayi, sirf aankhein cheekhti thin. Lock ne doosri key li aur khula jaise rokhi saans chhoot gayi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Wrist-chain masla thi — deewar mein gadi anguthi se rivet, koi key nahi chhu sakti. Tumne chisel wahan kas di jahan anguthi patthar milti thi, cloak uske aas-paas dabakar awaaz nigalne. Mortar dheere aaya, geele grey tukdon mein, har ghisai shaant qile mein ek shor.
Gallery ke end pe, Holt princess ki kisi baat pe hansaa. Accha. Hansi tez hoti hai.

Elara use thaame rahi — murmur, dheemi hansi, dheere aadhe circle mein ghumati jab tak uski peeth poori gallery ki taraf na ho. Ek baar usne bilkul kuch nahi pe chamakti khushi se hansi, bilkul jab tumhari chisel patthar pe cheekhi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Mortar chhoda. Anguthi grit ki phuhaar ke saath ukhdi, aur Nessa ki chain tumhare haathon mein dheeli giri. Tumne use uthaya — wazan kuch nahi — aur usne chehra tumhari gardan mein dabaya aur kampi, khamosh, aur tumne use waise thaama jaise chhoti thi.

"Behen," tumne saans mein kaha. "Main tumhe thaame hue hoon. Hum ja rahe hain. Koi awaaz nahi." Usne sir hilaya, phir sir uthaya tumhare peeche us aurat ko dekhne jo abhi bhi guard ko awaaz ki hatheli mein thaame thi. Pehchaan chehre pe daudi. "Ye wahi hai," muh se bina awaaz. "Jisse tum neend mein baatein karte ho."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tumne Nessa ki chain chhoti lapeti aur gallery se wapas chale. Ab bas Holt bacha tha — aur koi aadmi princess ko hamesha nahi takta, jab relief due ho aur andar koi jaanwar sa hissa sochta ho kyun khali cells mein taaze toot e mortar ki khushboo aa rahi hai.

Elara ne turn mehsoos ki tumse pehle. "Mujhe khidki tak le chalo," usne Holt se kaha, khushi se, shareer uski aankhon aur tum teeno ke beech rakhte hue jo peeche seedhi ki taraf nikal rahe the. "Phansi se pehle toofan dekhna hai." Holt, majboor, use khidki tak le gaya, aur gallery un sab se khali ho gayi jinhe rakhne ki uski duty thi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tum stairhead pe pahunche, Nessa peeth se dabii. Elara ne guard ko ek aakhri pal diya, phir bas usse andhere mein bahak gayi, tumhara haath uski kalai pakadkar seedhiyon pe neeche khinchta. Holt khali khidki pe der tak blink karta raha pehle ki samajhe jo sabse khoobsurat cheez uske saath hui thi, wo chor thi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Ab niche thandi seedhi pe teen — ek tooti princess, ek bhookhi behen, ek guard jisne har kasam tod di. Baayein mein Nessa ka haath, daayein mein Elara ka, dono aakhir deewar ke isi taraf.
"Naali," Elara ne whisper kiya. "Humein us deewar pe le chalo jo saans leti hai."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tum nadi ki awaaz aur taiyar skiff ki taraf neeche gaye. Peeche qila sota raha, abhi nahi jaanta uski sabse zalim cell khali hai aur jis princess ko phansi deni thi wo uski hi buniyadon se nikal rahi hai. Jald pata chalega. Par abhi nahi.
— Chapter 17 khatam —

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tum unhe buniyadon se neeche le gaye jaise sau baar dimaag mein chala chuke the — thandi niche passage jahan naali saans leti thi, dheele patthar jinhe tumne kai night-watch pe soft kiya tha, andhera jo lohe ki jagah nadi ki khushboo leta tha.

Elara chad nahi sakti thi aur Nessa mushkil se chal paati thi, to tum dheere gaye, dono pe ek-ek haath. Shayad tees kadam bache the saans lete pattharon se, jab bahut upar aur peeche, qile ne sona band kiya.
Ek ghanti se shuru hua. Phir har ghanti.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Vance soya nahi tha. Favor mein wapas aaya captain apni jeet ki raat nahi sota — aur feast aur quarters ke beech kahin wo neeche gaya tha us aurat ko dekhne jisne use sab kuch khudaya aur wapas diya.
Usne niche landing pe kharrate aadmi bikhre paaye, cell khuli aur khali, chains straw pe kati padi, abhi garam, aur mashal-wale ki ring se doosri key gayab.
Vance kai zalim cheezein hai par kabhi bewakoof nahi. Ek saans mein poora samajh gaya — guard, nigahen, kamzor dawai, princess jo nahi tooti — aur sir peeche phenk qile ko cheekhkar jaga diya.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Order uski awaaz mein nikla, seedhiyon se thande paani ki tarah: "Gaddar ke paas dushman princess hai aur uski khud ki behen! Har gate, har deewar! Jo use saans leti wapas laaye use sona — aur guard ka sir main khud chahta hoon!"

Saiakon boots, ek saath, keep ke har corridor mein. Tum saans lete pattharon pe pahunche aur kandha us mortar pe lagaya jise tumne chori ki raaton ke ek mahine mein patiently maara tha. Purana, bhoola sally-port khula geeli hawa aur khuli, toofan-kaali raat mein.

Tum teenon ko nadi ke upar slippery patthar pe bahar daal diya. Taiyar skiff reeds mein wait kar rahi thi, andhere mein pheeki — neeche bees-chaalis kadam. Chaalis kadam tumhare aur us kale paani ke beech jo azaad le jaata.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tum unhe le ja nahi paaye.

Peeche tooti deewar se mashalein bahi — aur aage tower ke pair pe aur aayi, line patthar pe failti. Vance ne sirf peecha nahi kiya; bahar se aadmi ghumaye the. Das dhadkanon mein tum almost-azaad se ghere mein aa gaye: teenon garti nadi ki peeth pe, dono taraf sipahi bandh rahe.

Tumne kamar pe chhoti guard talwar khainchi — ek talwar, bhallon ke kaskte daayre ke khilaaf, peeche zakhmi princess aur baaju se chipki behen. Ye larai nahi thi. Ye ending se pehle ke chand second the.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Aur phir Elara tumhare aage nikal gayi.

Wo tumhare aage mashal ki roshni aur baarish mein nikli — aur tumpe waar ki tarah pada ki do saal mein pehli baar tumne use aise khada dekha jiske kalaiyon pe kuch nahi. Koi chains nahi. Koi shackle nahi. Koi rassi nahi. Bas ek princess apne do pairon pe, khule aasmaan ke neeche.

Usne tumhari talwar nahi pakdi. Gira bhalla nahi pakda. Khali haath bagal mein dheele chhode, aur dheere, irade se, barbaad kandhe peeche kiye aur thodi uthayi, aur tumhe samajh aaya ab tum wo cheez dekhne wale ho jo raja ke dungeon ne kabhi bahar nahi nikalne di.

"Apni behen bachao." Usne peeche tumhe nahi dekha; aankhein pehle se sipahiyon pe chalti thin, ginti, naap. "Ye iklauta order hai jo maine tumhe kabhi diya jise maan'na zaroori hai. Nessa ko unche ilaake le jao. Main unhe yahan rokungi."
"Elara—" Tumhari awaaz uspe toot gayi.

"Isse pehle ki main kaidi banun, isse pehle ki kabhi jung ki princess," bahut dheere kaha, "main apni maa ke ghar ke training courts mein bacchi thi, aur unhone blade denese pehle open-hand forms sikhaye. Do saal ke lohe ne ye mujhse nahi chheena. In aadmiyon ko seekhne do meri watan betiyon ko kya sikhata hai."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Wo ek tezi se jhuki aur barbaad skirt ka geela peeche latakta hem phaada, geele kapde ko jaangh pe chhota aur kasakar baandha taaki pair uljhe na — fighter apna footwork saaf karti, bas. Phir nange pair geele patthar pe set kiye, wazan neeche litaya, aur haath aage guard mein uthaye jo tumne kabhi nahi dekha: ek hatheli khuli aage, ek kamar pe peeche, kohni naram, saans dheemi.

Andar kahin gehra, daag aur lash-daag aur marode kandhon ke neeche, ek purani awaaz ubhri — pehle master ki, dhoop wale aangan se, ek zindagi aur ek jung door. Pehle sthirta, awaaz ne kaha. Unhe larai tum tak laane do. Tumhe das aadmiyon se zyada mazboot nahi hona. Unke jahan nahi, bilkul wahan hona.
Usne saans chhodi. Intezaar kiya.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Pehla sipahi tez aur bedaul aaya, bhalla pet pe. Wo usse peeche nahi hati — andar kadam rakha, line se hatke, kamar ghumayi, aur uske hi waar ko aage le jaane diya; aage wali hatheli jabde ke neeche snap hui poore ghumao ke saath, sir peeche gaya, pair udhe, patthar pe pada aur nahi utha.
Ek, usne socha. Form abhi bhi andar hai. Purane bhagwan ka shukr, abhi bhi hai.

Phata hoth phir khoon de raha tha aur usne waar padte mehsoos bhi nahi kiya. Almost shaanti thi. Do saal mein pehli baar shareer uska tha, wo kaam kar raha tha jiske liye shape hua tha pehle ki duniya use dard sikhati.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Doosra aur teesra saath aaye, hoshiyar, do taraf se gherne. Wo unke beech paani ki tarah behi jo neeche jagah dhoondhta hai — neeche sweeping laat jisne baayein aadmi ka ghutna nikaal diya, pivot, kohni daayein ki pasliyon mein, uski hi kalai ka marod jisne bhalla andhere mein khadkhada diya. Gira. Gira.

Par keemat padi, aur tumne dekha keemat padi. Jab laat oonchi snap ki, strappado-marode kandhe cheekhe aur baaju thoda dheere gira; jab mudi, seene pe aadhe bharte lash-zakhm baarish mein phir phat gaye, aur patli kaali lakeer barbaad kapde se behi. Phata skirt pivot ke beech khul gaya aur takhne uljha — usne form tode bina gusse se phaadkar alag kiya.

Har waar ek udhaar tha jo uska bhookha, torture hua shareer sach mein nahi de sakta tha. Usne phir bhi diya, aur muskurati rahi, kyunki zameen pe har sipahi tumhari behen ki zindagi ka ek aur second tha.
"BHAGO!" cheekhi — mude bina, awaaz shabd pe saaf do tukde, aansu aur baarish chehre pe jo abhi bhi, asambhav, lad raha tha. "Jo kuch bacha uske pyar se — use lo aur BHAGO!"

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tumhara har hissa jisne cords dheele kiye, aansu ponchhe, use us lambi kaali seedhi pe uthaya, cheekh raha tha uske bagal marne ko. Tum peeche kadam nahi badhe. Tum uski taraf kadam badhe.
"Main tumhe nahi chhod raha," tumne kaha, aur mushkil se pata tha kaha. "Main is jagah isliye utra tha ki tumhe nikaalun. Main bina tumhare yahan se nahi nikal raha—"

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Aur phir Nessa — chhoti, bhookhi, dari Nessa — dono haathon se tumhara talwar-baaju jakadkar peeche khincha jitna wazan bacha tha.
"Wo humein ye DE rahi hai!" behen tumhare kandhe pe sisaki. "Ise barbaad mat karna. Mat banana ki usne ye bekaar mein kiya — BHAGO, bhai, bhago, BHAGO!"

To tum mud gaye. Ye sabse mushkil kaam tha jo tumne kabhi kiya, aur zindagi bhar uthoge: tumne princess ki peeth ki jo baarish mein akele lad rahi thi, aur bhaage, behen ka haath mutthi mein kuchla, kale track pe unche ilaake ki taraf.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Peeche mashal ki roshni gehri hui. Ab tooti deewar se nayi lehar sipahiyon ki bah rahi thi, aur zyada, tang patthar ki shelf pe bharte, aur baarish mein tumhari aakhri peeche jhaank ek chhoti akeli shakl thi sabke beech — abhi khadi, abhi hilti, abhi aadmiyon ko sirf haath-pair aur natoot, antooti marzi se hatati.
Phir track muda, aur patthar tumhare beech uth gaye, aur wo nazron se gayab — par nahi, tumne toofan mein kasam khayi, poori tarah gayab nahi.
— Chapter 18 khatam —

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tum bhaagte rahe jab tak nadi door neeche chaandi ka dhaaga na ban gayi aur qila door mashalon ka jhund, jab tak phephde aag na ho gaye aur behen ke pair fail na hone lage. Tum bhaagte rahe jab tak zameen sakht oopar na jhuki aur kale pahaad aage bade na uth khade hue, aur jab Nessa ek kadam aur nahi le saki tab ruke, patthar ke oonche thande kandhe pe, mude, aur us raaste pe dekha jahan se aaye the.
Bahut, bahut neeche, paani ke upar us chhoti patthar ki shelf pe, tum abhi bhi use dekh sakte the. Aur dil ruk gaya.
Ab teen sipahi nahi thaam rahi thi. Dus thaam rahi thi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Ek akeli shakl mashalon ke daayre mein, peeche kaali nadi, aage dus hathiyar band aadmi bandhata chaap — aur wo abhi bhi nange haath lad rahi thi, jaise maa ke ghar ne aangan mein sikhaya tha, ek jung aur ek zindagi door.

Itni bhayankar doori pe bhi tum forms padh sakte the: wo bhalla seedha kabhi nahi milati, ghumati, peeche nikal jati, aadmi ke khud ke wazan ko uske khilaaf use karti; ek baar, sakht, bilkul jahan khula ho, maarti, aur girne se pehle hil chuki hoti. Gale pe hatheli. Ghutne ke peeche edi. Ghumao jo do ko andhere mein ek doosre pe girata.
Center thaame raho, purani awaaz andar boli, dhoop wali subah jaisi shaant. Dus aadmi ek saath tum tak nahi pahunch sakte. Unhe bari do. Har ek se keemat lo.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tum nahi jaante the — jaan nahi sakte the — waisa dikhane ki keemat kya thi.

Jo shareer itna khoobsurat hil raha tha, uske andar sab ek saath fail ho raha tha. Bhookhi muscles bache thode ko bhi jala rahi thin. Collarbone ke neeche daag khal ke neeche koyla tha. Seene pe lash-zakhm poori tarah phat chuke the aur baarish barbaad dress ke aage se gulabi beh rahi thi. Marode kandhe har block pe cheekhte. Aur nange pair aur pinne, geele patthar pe dhajjiyan, har kadam pe kaale nishan chhodte.
Ek aur, usne khud se kaha, jab koi aur aadmi aaya. Ek saans. Ek form. Ek aur, aur wo pahaad se ek saans door. Thaame raho. Bas thaame.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Phata skirt sipahiyon jitna hi ladta tha. Geela, phaada kapda ghutnon pe ulajhta, laatein chheeneta, har pivot pe balance daraata, aur do baar larai ke beech ek haath se phaadna pada, gusse se, inkaar ki ek kapde ka tukda wo kare jo dus aadmi nahi kar sake.

Usne nahi karne diya. Kasakar baandha, khoon bharte pair aur chaure kiye, center neeche rakha, aur chalti rahi — kyunki kale pahaad pe kahin do log the jinhe usne bachane ka faisla kiya tha abhi chadhte, aur uske khoon ki princess nahi rukti jab tak doori kharidne ko ek saans bachi ho.
Isi ke liye main hoon, usne socha, dard ke dhundhlepan mein almost hairaan. Spring nahi. Takht nahi. Ye. Jinhe pyar karti hoon unke aur andhere ke beech khadi. Ye hi ho.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Aur phir, aakhir, wo chhoot gayi.

Ek waar nahi tha. Do saal ek saath wasool — cradle, press, daag, strappado, bina khane-paani-neend ke din — aur shareer, chahe kitna bahadur, seekha, shahi, itna hi kharch ho sakta usse pehle khinchne ko kuch na bache.

Uske pair, kate khoon bhare aur kamapte, aakhir jawab nahi diya. Ooncha block ek dhadkan late. Pivot nahi ghuma. Khoobsurat, behti forms atki aur toot gayi, aur pehli baar aadmiyon ka daayra usse tez tha.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Ek guard ne peeche se pakda, dono kalaiyan mutthiyon mein.
Tab bhi — kharch, khatam — bas haar nahi maani. Wazan giraya, pakad ke andar mudi jaise forms sikhate, ek haath chhudaya aur kohni itni zor peeche maari ki wo mud gaya aur chhod diya.
Par ye uska aakhri tha. Uske baad kuch nahi. Aur baaki ne bhi dekh liya.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Chaar ek saath uspe bandhe. Phir paanch. Unhone baaju, kandhe pakde, shareeron ke wazan se neeche dabaya, warrior ko armored aadmiyon ke press ke neeche jakda jo ek minute pehle uske paas aane ki himmat nahi karte.
Aur phir bhi — Bhagwan, phir bhi — ladi. Kamzor, dagmagati, thakaan aur dard se aadhi andhi, haathon ke khilaaf tani, marodti, sthir hone se inkaar, kyunki sthir hona wo cheez hai jo use aati nahi.
Pahaad se tumne dekha aur saans nahi le paaye. Nessa ne chehra tumhari bagal mein dabaya taaki na dekhna pade.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Wo jaanti thi. Andar koi saaf, shaant hissa, ab bhi, bilkul jaanta tha ye kaise khatam hota hai — poori fauj ek bhookhi, chains-se-azad princess ke khilaaf geele patthar ki patti pe, aur hisab ka ek hi jawab. Jeetna nahi tha. Kabhi nahi tha.

Phir bhi ladi. Jo kuch bhi rooh bachi, jo aakhri forms shareer abhi yaad rakhta, aise ladi jaise ending jaanti hi na ho — kyunki larai jeetne ki nahi thi. Second ki thi, aur har second tum aur Nessa kale pahaadon mein ek kadam door unki pahunch se.

Aur phir, ek saans aur agli ke beech, andhera bas utha aur nazren nigal gaya. Shareer — princess ka shareer, taakat ko janma, uthaya, usi ke liye bana — dene ko kuch nahi; cradle aur press aur daag aur bhookh ke mahinon ne aakhri kharch kar diya. Ghutne mude. Mashal ki roshni dhundhli aur bujhi. Geele patthar pe fold hui, girne se pehle behosh.

Uske taraf se ho gaya. Unhe kaafi der thaame rakha. Do log jinhe pyar karti thi safe the, door kale pahaad pe jahan aaj raat koi sipahi nahi aayega — aur aakhri thartharate pal mein andhera aane se pehle, ye jaankar, muskurayi. Phir behosh ho gayi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Phir, patli hoti baarish mein, tumne use aate dekha.
Vance. Ab bina jaldi. Mashal ki roshni mein chalta, dono haath mein chains ikatthi, time leta, maza leta — iklauta inaam jo poori raat mana nahi kar saki.

Unhone uska dheela, behosh shareer thaame rakha jab usne chains lagayi. Pehle kalaiyan. Phir lohe ka collar. Phir lambi, bhaari chain — wapas uspe lock, link-link, har loha cheez jisse wo khule aasmaan ke neeche azaad hone khadi hui thi, ab ek aurat pe kasaa jo itni door chali gayi thi ki band hote mehsoos bhi na kare.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Wapas chalana mumkin nahi tha. Wo usse kaafi aage nikal chuki thi.

Do sipahiyon ne bagalon se pakda aur dheele ko beech mein khincha, kate nange pair geele patthar pe ghisate, kata sir dheela latakta. Jo princess ek ghante pehle dus hathiyar band aadmiyon ko rok rahi thi, use behosh uthakar gate ki taraf le gaye, usi qile mein jisse nikalne ke liye usne khoon bahaya, ladi, aur khud ka aakhri kharch kiya.
Wo andhera jisse usne tumse kabhi na lene ko kaha tha, use wapas le raha tha, aur is duniya pe ek cheez nahi thi jo tum hazaar feet upar pahaad se kar sakte.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tum us oonche patthar ke kandhe pe khade unhe uski behosh shakl patthar se neeche le jaate dekhte rahe, aur saans nahi, hil nahi sakte the, aur nazar nahi hata sakte the.
Zindagi bhar har raat aankhon ke peeche ye dikhega: sir latakta, baaju dheele, kalaiyon pe chains hilti, mashal ki roshni nigalti, andhera phir uspe band.

Bagal, Nessa ne chehra tumhari bagal mein dabaya aur roi, aur tumne use thaama, aur kisi ne ek shabd nahi kaha, kyunki duniya mein koi shabd nahi bacha tha jo tumne abhi use tumhare khatir karte dekha.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Par us pal tumne ek cheez thaame rakhi, aur dinon ke baaki bhi thaame rahoge.

Aakhri cheez jo usne ki, wahan dus aadmiyon ke beech, pehle ki andhera utha aur le gaya — tum itne door the ki sach mein dekh nahi sakte the, aur phir bhi jaante the, jaise hamesha use jaante the: wo muskurayi thi.

Usne khud ki aakhri boond kharch ki aur iklauti jeet jeeti jo kabhi chahi thi — tumhari — aur jaante hue tum dono door kale pahaad pe azaad aur na pakde, chhod diya aur andhere mein khushi se utri. Chehra ek aurat ka jisne sab kho diya aur kuch nahi pachtaya.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Phir unhone use gate se khincha, aur qile ka andhera princess pe phir band hua, aur wo nahi hili.
Tum thande pahaad pe khade, behen ka haath mutthi mein kuchla, peeche grey subah uthati — azaad, aur barbaad, aur bilkul ek cheez pe pakke.
"Main tumhe lene wapas aaunga," tumne hawa mein kaha jo use nahi le ja sakti thi. "Jo bhi lage. Kitni bhi der. Main wapas aaunga. Kasam — abhi ye end nahi hai."
— Aage jaari… —
